title: Task List - Status filter retains tasks after Select all minus two statuses
preconditions: Use a practice whose Task List has tasks in at least three statuses, including a task in a status that will remain selected. Note that task's name and status before filtering.
description: Regression coverage for WMD-1965's written acceptance criterion: the Tasks view must show tasks in the remaining selected statuses after Select all and deselecting a couple of statuses.

steps.action: Open the Tasks view and clear any existing filters.
steps.expected_result: The Task List displays the known task and its status.

steps.action: Open the Status column filter and choose Select all.
steps.expected_result: All status options are selected, and tasks remain visible.

steps.action: Deselect two statuses, leaving the known task's status selected, and apply the filter.
steps.expected_result: The known task remains visible. Every displayed task has one of the remaining selected statuses; tasks in either deselected status are absent.
The full unfiltered task list returns, including tasks in the two previously deselected statuses.
